Canvas tool rail composes decorative SVG in public prefix slot and compact text in label slot; control part and public rest/hover/border/radius tokens restore icon-over-label visuals. Disabled control part remains transparent/muted; public native focus, disabled state and toolbar interaction remain owned by EnButton/EnToolbar.
Session client owns authority and credentials in closures; popup contains display state only.
App owns selected operation and draft; settled en-change adapter. Public control/focus-frame parts and --en-select-appearance opt out of data-URI caret under unchanged strict CSP.
Native input/IME/undo/selection; app owns independent operation drafts, generation fences and durable UI receipts.
Public pointer/keyboard value contract; app grid track 1px, margin-inline calc(-1 * ((var(--_en-split-target) - 1px) / 2)), z-index 1; full target remains interactive.
File choice/drop is a settled proposal only; app stages original bytes, verifies exact identity and prepares an explicit Apply/Cancel review.

Public plain-text label/selection contract fits: name, visible/hidden and locked status. App supplies flat layer order, owns selection and separate inspector controls; no interactive descendants in tree labels.
App stages drafts with base revision; native controls preserve editing; authoritative writes and delayed proposals use generation fencing; only Apply dispatches typed edits.
Public tab interaction; unavailable Composition/results/jobs are explained truthfully.
Public feed renderItem composition and accessible paging; app reads bounded backend pages, dispatches retained branch/checkpoint commands.

Public drawer with keyboard/focus behavior and app-owned workflow guidance.

surfaces.surface: Selection, brush, feather, PNG-mask alignment and sampling
surfaces.owner: Public mode/field/native editing, settled final-veto adapters. App retains canonical document coordinates, hard/effective R16 draft generations, exact sampled RGBA, and explicit reviewed attachment. Sample RGBA feedback uses a persistent public EnAlert with announcement=polite; bounds and new baseline review explanations use EnAlert announcement=none.
Public disclosure and focus semantics; canvas tool state chooses authoring visibility.

surfaces.surface: Status, draft labels, pending recovery and download records
surfaces.owner: Persistent public patterns preserve distinct accepted/draft/stale/outdated/unconfirmed messages inside stable operation-status section; no custom status or disclosure control.

surfaces.owner: Public navigation and decorative icon; trusted build-owned report URL and existing focus target logic retained.

nativeOrAppOwnedExceptions.contract: UX canvas/raster ownership and DS app-owned raster exception; no public En Reve raster editor/compositor. Display pixels are separate from exact retained backend export.

nativeOrAppOwnedExceptions.element: Native ClipboardEvent, DragEvent, PointerEvent and keyboard handlers
nativeOrAppOwnedExceptions.contract: No public En Reve raster editor or canonical document-coordinate gesture contract. CanvasView inverts the displayed viewport; move release applies one atomic transform, brush release appends one recoverable operation. Public fields/actions supply numeric alternatives; late veto, Escape and revision fences remain app-owned.

nativeOrAppOwnedExceptions.surface: Document landmarks, two-dimensional layout and exact prepared image
nativeOrAppOwnedExceptions.element: Semantic HTML headings/regions, CSS grid and img
nativeOrAppOwnedExceptions.contract: Semantic document structure and 2D viewport geometry are app-owned. Exact prepared image load gates use its actual currentSrc; En Reve has no canonical raster display/load contract. Adjacent statuses use Alert/Badge, records use Card/Stack, disclosure uses Accordion and links use EnLink.

nativeOrAppOwnedExceptions.element: File System Access writable or verified disk-backed browser download
nativeOrAppOwnedExceptions.contract: Browser destination authority is app-owned; EnFileUpload chooses incoming files and does not acknowledge external writes. Writable close confirms only the supported browser destination operation; download initiation stays unconfirmed.
Mandated LS-1 and DS pre-upgrade exception; security/bootstrap order and no-script launcher instructions retained.

nativeOrAppOwnedExceptions.surface: Extreme reflow (<=720 CSS px, including 320px and 200%-equivalent)
nativeOrAppOwnedExceptions.element: Named single-column regions with persistent EnButton openers
nativeOrAppOwnedExceptions.contract: UX single-scrollable-column reflow; coordinator task clarification permits this composition only at extreme reflow. Pinned EnDrawer public API is modal-only with no inline/nonmodal mode. Intermediate narrow widths retain public EnDrawer; fields remain the same native nodes.

nativeOrAppOwnedExceptions.element: Persistent plain text with accessible description association; public EnButton and EnDrawer remain
nativeOrAppOwnedExceptions.contract: Coordinator-approved strict-CSP exception in task292d3ac5. Pinned EnTooltip bind inserts an empty and dynamic anchor stylesheet; its public tooltip/position-controller API offers no nonce or disable-anchor setting. Attempts32/33 show application-triggered style-src-elem violations. No bespoke tooltip, private override, vendor patch or CSP relaxation.

nativeOrAppOwnedExceptions.element: Adjacent public EnButton Move up/Move down
nativeOrAppOwnedExceptions.contract: Inspected pinned EnTree reorderable/openMove/en-reorder: public move proposals include inside; no public position filter exists. This document has a flat layer list, so no nesting proposal is offered. One button action dispatches MoveLayers.

nativeOrAppOwnedExceptions.element: Decorative SVG in public EnButton prefix slot
nativeOrAppOwnedExceptions.contract: Pinned public icon catalog lacks move/selection/mask/crop/sample/hand/zoom tool symbols. Existing custom glyphs remain aria-hidden; public button label, focus, disabled and pressed semantics own interaction.

inventory.limitations: Browser automation and synthetic composition are not native OS IME, AT, native picker, platform or power-loss qualification. Startup bytes and visual/runtime receipts are separate evidence. No component inventory entry self-approves user feedback. Authored mask support hatching shows its bounding extent, not a provider-safe interior. Exact hard/effective previews are separately labelled. Attached crop/resize uses versioned retained grids and outside-domain zero coverage, including inversion; no re-feather or clipped-byte replacement on bounds changes. New draft Apply can explicitly re-feather original hard coverage on the current document. Physical IME/AT/full-envelope resource and platform qualification remain P3/A-R01.

qualification: Public pinned API adoption; author inventory only, no human review or independent approval
